Definition
[Radial intrinsic distance and small-sphere maps] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0489, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0490 1. appi:eq-1.13,appi:eq-1.14\group Distance spheres For $0<s\le t<\inj (p)$ let \[ \varphi _{s,t}=\exp _p\circ (t/s)\circ (\exp _p|_{\overline B(0,s)})^{-1}:S(p,s)\to S(p,t), \] and let $\dhat _{S(p,s)}$ be the intrinsic length distance induced by the subspace metric on $S(p,s)$. In Euclidean space the corresponding maps are isometries after scaling by $1/s$ and $1/t$.
